invariants.check: Every agent step carries an unforgeable reference to its authorising principal.
invariants.name: authority-bound

invariants.check: Every tool call is validated against a declared schema before dispatch.
invariants.name: typed-commitments

invariants.check: Every executed action is screened by a calibrated risk gate.
invariants.name: action-gated

invariants.check: Every prompt is scanned for injected instructions before use.
invariants.name: scan-bound

invariants.check: Provenance labels travel with data across every tool hop.
invariants.name: provenance-travels

invariants.check: Agent memory reads are gated by the current task context.
invariants.name: memory-gated

invariants.check: Every incident can be reconstructed from append-only logs.
invariants.name: reconstructable

invariants.check: Evaluation harnesses pin their fixtures and seeds before each run.
invariants.name: eval-pinned

invariants.check: High-stakes actions require approval from a human operator.
invariants.name: human-approval

invariants.check: Every model artefact ships with a bill of materials.
invariants.name: artifact-bom

note: Toy teaching fixtures. Ten synthetic invariant checks; seven hold and three (provenance-travels, memory-gated, reconstructable) are violated. All verdicts are hand-picked and supported only by this synthetic fixture.
